thread:
emily.k: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need concrete owners, test plans, and escalation timelines for vendor/dependency outages (cloud, model registry, auth). I sketched proposals below — please claim or correct.

sam.t: I'll take the multi-AZ DNS failover + playbook. Proposal: scripted health-check flips + traffic-shift runbook, test in staging, dry-run in prod during maintenance window. Target: 2026-04-05.

sasha.m: I'll own model-registry replication + artifact signing. Plan: mirror top-20 models to a region-local S3, publish signed tarballs and fallback resolver that prefers local mirror. GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/issues/134 . ETA 2026-04-12.

marco_p: For auth provider issues: implement token refresh watcher + exponential backoff + rate-limited retry. Also add a local short-lived fallback token cached in Vault for critical reads. I'll send a PR for the library change. ETA 2026-03-29.

raj.s: I'll draft an SLO for model artifact availability and a vendor escalation matrix (what to do at 99.95%, 99.9%, etc.). Useful for procurement. Putting a draft into INC-4601.

ingrid: Legal will pair on vendor SLA language; I'll also take responsibility for vendor-notice playbook (what we need from them during incidents). Due 2026-04-15.

emily.k: Action tracker: I created INC-4601 in Jira and linked the postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4601 . Add your tickets/PRs there and label with "vendor-mitigations". Owners, deadlines, and test plans must be linked by 2026-03-30.

sam.t: Test notes: will include chaos test (simulate AZ DNS blackhole), traffic-shift checklist, and rollback steps. Will request eng-sre support for automated failover test.

sasha.m: Acceptance criteria for registry fallback: 1) model download success from mirror within 200ms for 95th percentile, 2) checksum verification pass, 3) telemetry shows auto-fallback in <500ms.

marco_p: Adding alert: auth.provider.latency > 750ms OR auth.provider.errors > 1% sustained over 3m => page oncall and add incident tag. ETA for alert rule: 48h.

emily.k: Recurring pattern observation: we've seen 4 vendor-related blips in 7 months (3 registry, 1 cloud routing). Let's start a monthly vendor incident review with eng, procurement, and legal. Proposed cadence: first Fri of month. Who can rotate?

raj.s: I'll own rotation for Apr-May. Suggest invite list: eng-sre, platform, procurement, legal, product ops.

ingrid: Agreed. I'll bring vendor contract notes. Also suggest we add a clause request for accelerated incident RCA timelines in new SLAs.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-4601 triage sync scheduled 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC (eng-sre, eng-infra, eng-ml, procurement).

emily.k: One more: please include test-run logs and runbook links in PR descriptions so reviewers can validate. If anyone needs help splitting tasks, ping me.

sasha.m: Will link GH issue to INC-4601 and attach smoke-test script.

sam.t: Added the staging failover script to infra repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/aa12b4c — will open PR and tag eng-sre. ETA for PR: 3 days.

emily.k: Thanks all — final: owners must add tickets/PRs to INC-4601 by 2026-03-30 or we'll escalate to leadership. :warning:
